# Honghui Du — computational mechanics research

> Research by Honghui Du and collaborators on neural meshfree approximation, differentiable simulation, inverse modeling, and strain-gradient elasticity.

## Research and publications

- [Research](https://honghui-du.github.io/research/): Research themes, method contributions, publications, and available code.
- [Publication list](https://honghui-du.github.io/publications/): Bibliographic overview.
- [Paper records](https://honghui-du.github.io/research/papers.json): Structured metadata generated from the publication pages.
